Usage: demo [OPTIONS] INPUT

Options:
  -v, --verbose              enable verbose output
  --output <FILE>            write output to FILE
  --color[=<WHEN>]           colorize output
                             possible values: auto, always, never
  -I<DIR>                    add DIR to the search path
  -version                   print the version
  --repeat                   repeatable; may be specified multiple times
  --no-color                 disable color
  --broken ???                malformed declaration

Arguments:
  INPUT                      input path

This prose mentions --fabricated but is not an option declaration.
  -                         malformed declaration

Examples:
  demo -v input.txt
  demo --fabricated input.txt
